name: Join Greeter
summary: Welcome every player by name when they join, show newcomers your server rules and hand them a starter kit you choose.
logoPrompt: A wooden door standing open with warm golden light pouring out of the doorway, set in a small stone frame, in blocky voxel style, no text

cover.tagline: A warm welcome for every player.

description: **Join Greeter welcomes players by name when they join your server, shows newcomers the rules and can hand them a starter kit.**
- One message for first-time players and another one for everyone who comes back.
- Optional rule lines under the welcome, for newcomers only or on every join.
- Optional starter kit for first-time players, set by item id and count; it is empty until you fill it.
- Colours with `&` codes such as `&6` or `&l`, and the placeholders `{player}` and `{online}`.
Put the jar into the server's `mods` folder next to Fabric API and start the server once. Then edit `config/joingreeter.json` (the file explains every code) and restart.
- Made for Fabric on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 dedicated servers and needs Fabric API.
- Only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- A first-time player is someone without statistics in this world, so players from before the install count as returning.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
